name: Escacena del Campo (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of black, white and yellow, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Escacena del Campo (a horseman on white).
history: Municipal flag of Escacena del Campo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Escacena del Campo arms — horseman on white
cap of the crown of the arms
